support_claim: crm:HEL-441 denotes Helion Robotics Ltd while registry:11847299 denotes Helion Industrial Systems Ltd, and evidence explicitly establishes that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from Helion Robotics.

propositions.proposition: CRM row HEL-441 records the account name Helion Robotics Ltd.
propositions.relevance: Grounds left referent crm:HEL-441 to Helion Robotics Ltd.

propositions.proposition: Registry row 11847299 records the company name HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.
propositions.relevance: Grounds right referent registry:11847299 to HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.

propositions.proposition: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM.
propositions.relevance: Confirms the CRM-side naming associated with the left referent.

propositions.proposition: Invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited, and that is the same legal entity as Helion Robotics Ltd.
propositions.relevance: Establishes identity between Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited, clarifying the legal counterparty denoted by the left referent; does not link the right referent.

propositions.proposition: Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company.
propositions.relevance: Explicitly states that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is not the same legal entity as Helion Robotics, bearing directly on whether crm:HEL-441 and registry:11847299 denote the same counterparty.

propositions.proposition: Helion Industrial Systems Ltd sold sensors in 2018 and has no current MSA.
propositions.relevance: Provides operational separation context for Helion Industrial Systems Ltd relative to the active CRM account on the left.
